### TITLE
feat(dotc1z): opt-in slim-blob grant writer with reader hydration

### BODY
## Summary

Strip Entitlement and Principal from grant data blobs and rebuild identity
stubs at read time.

## Measurements (redacted fixture)

Validation against a Synthetic-Acme target shows the c1z is smaller after
the slim writer runs; the previous run carried 489 grants of duplicated
embedded protos.

## Reference

Profile of be-temporal-sync prod surfaces the same hot path on every large
sync.
